pages.text: This region has been tainted by the presence of modifiers, such as [Global Gamerules] and [More MobGriefing options], and creepers here do not destroy blocks upon explosion, this, however, makes villagers too lazy to pickup crops or farm, if you are an [ADMINISTRATOR] you can make villagers exempt from the rules of [MobGriefing] using [More MobGriefing Options]
